items.title: DOJ weighs joining state antitrust suit against BlackRock and State Street -report
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Department of Justice is actively weighing whether to intervene in a high-stakes state antitrust lawsuit against asset management giants BlackRock Inc (NYSE:BLK) and State Street Corp (NYSE:STT), Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter. items.title: State Street (STT) Names Mostapha Tahiri And Ann Fogarty To New Leadership Roles
items.summary: State Street (NYSE: STT) announced major leadership changes, assigning Mostapha Tahiri and Ann Fogarty to expanded global roles. Mostapha Tahiri becomes president of State Street Alpha and chairman of Asia Pacific, overseeing the front to back platform and regional business. Ann Fogarty is appointed enterprise chief operating officer with responsibility for technology, AI and firm wide transformation initiatives. items.title: Q&A: State Street Goes Live With Custody Offering
items.summary: State Street is now marketing its RIA clearing and custody business, targeting larger RIAs, and plans to go live with an anchor client in the U.S. in the next couple of months, says John Plansky, head of State Street Wealth Services.

items.title: Is State Street Corporation Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?

items.summary: Roundhill's AI-focused fund delivered 55.2% returns but carries higher volatility and fees. State Street's broader tech ETF offers lower costs and steadier performance for long-term investors.
